week-view.description: Time-grid with one to seven visible days, an all-day row, overlapping event blocks, and a time-zone now-line.

drag.note: Drag an empty slot span to propose a create, drag a block to propose a move, or drag its top/bottom edges to propose a resize. Keyboard parity: arrows move, Shift+arrows resize, Enter confirms, Escape cancels. The lib never mutates the array — proposals land in the log below.

examples.note: Use the toolbar to move the visible range and switch between day, 3-day, 4-day, and week layouts. Clicking an hour slot emits the wall time in the display zone; the log below shows emitted events.

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone week view component.

locales.note: Weekdays, hours, and helper texts follow the selected locale.

props.note: Pass events (the lib expands recurrence without mutating the array), tasks, resolved holidays, and the display time zone. Drag proposes creates, moves, and resizes with a snap step; year and schedule views stay click and keyboard only.

size-density.note: Size drives block text while density drives the hour height.

week-view.title: Week View
